messages:
maria_marketing: Quick kickoff: we're running a micro-experiment to simplify pricing language and add a micro-calculator targeted at mid-market dev teams. main goals: clearer copy, higher demo-booking rate, and smarter lead routing.

ravi_growth: +1. what conversion uplift are we baking into the hypothesis?

maria_marketing: aim for demo clicks +0.9pp (from 1.6% to 2.5%) and a 10% lift in qualified leads from pricing page.

sue_product: proposal for labels: "Sandbox" / "Team" / "Committing" — one short line each, and small badges for features (SLA, VPC, reserved GPU). avoid Pro/Enterprise wording.

ana_design: i'll mock a compact horizontal band with microcopy under labels and a small calculator that sits inline on desktop and collapses to a sticky CTA on mobile.

leo_eng: FYI the calculator will use a simple formula: tokens_per_month * price_per_1k_by_tier + optional private fee. i'll add client-side telemetry events for each interaction.

toni_sales: routing ask: when someone selects "Committing" and checks "I need SLA/VPC", create a high priority lead in SFDC with note: "pricing-calc: SLA/VPC interest". also include est_monthly and utm params.

remy_cs: i'll prepare a 2-line FAQ snippet to sit under the calc results: billing cadence and cancellation policy. keep it very short.

ravi_growth: A/B plan?

maria_marketing: 60/40 split (more traffic to variant to get signal faster): control = current page, variant = simplified labels + inline calc + micro-FAQ. run 3 weeks or 6k sessions. primary KPI = demo_CTR; secondary = calc_use_rate, lead_quality.

ana_design: microcopy for calc tooltip draft: "Estimates are ballpark. Includes token costs only; excludes egress and private infra fees. For contract pricing, tick the box."

leo_eng: technical note: we will emit events: pricing_calc_open, pricing_calc_input, pricing_calc_submit, pricing_calc_optin_contract. ravi please wire these to analytics.

remy_cs: follow-up flow: if high-priority lead -> AE + CS get automated slack alert + onboarding kit sent. otherwise send nurture sequence.

ci_bot: Reminder: Experiment "pricing micro-calc + compact labels" scheduled to deploy 2026-08-02 04:00 UTC. CI window 03:00-05:00 UTC.

maria_marketing: action items: ana designs, leo implement calc + events, ravi tracking + looker slice, remy support copy, toni webhook + sfdc mapping. reconvene 48 hours before deploy. :thumbsup:
